168	def advisory_to_indicator(advisory_dict: dict) -> dict:
169	    """Convert the advisory dictionary into an indicator dictionary

172	        advisory_dict: advisory dictionary
173	    Returns:
174	        indicator dictionary
175	    """
176	
177	    fields: dict = {}
178	
179	    if problem_type := advisory_dict.get("problemtype"):

182	        cwe_str: str = problem_type.get('problemtype_data', [{}])[0].get('description', [{}])[0].get('value', "")
183	
184	        if cwe_str and cwe_str.startswith('CWE-'):
185	            # split this string after the CWE-\d* first space
186	            # CWE-754 Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
187	            cwe = cwe_str.split(" ", 1)

190	            tags.append(cwe[0])

192	
193	    if references := advisory_dict.get("references"):
